title: construct
description: A prompt or elicitation pattern an agent uses. Governed content that happens to be prose.

carries_domain_terms.description: A construct carrying a domain term is pack content; a domain-free one is platform content. The line is thin and the answer belongs on the record.

transfers.description: Whether this leaves with a tenant at exit. Know-how usually does not, and marking it here is what makes the export honest.
